summary: Check Point Software Technologies furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-11-02 reporting third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue was $670 million, down 1% year over year, with security subscriptions up 11% to $339 million; GAAP operating income $177 million (26% margin) and non-GAAP $251 million (37%). GAAP EPS was $1.82 and non-GAAP $2.49, each down sharply versus prior year, which included a one-time ~$1.47 tax benefit. Cash and securities were $4,123 million. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; buybacks and convertible issuance are noted contextually.
